rules.title: Severe Hemorrhage Risk (Warfarin + Aspirin)
rules.description: Concurrent use of anticoagulants and antiplatelet agents markedly increases gastrointestinal and intracranial bleeding risk.
rules.evidence: FDA Black Box Warning & CHEST Guidelines for Antithrombotic Therapy.
rules.recommendation: Avoid combination unless strictly indicated for mechanical valve. Monitor INR closely.

rules.title: Major Bleeding Hazard (Anticoagulant + NSAID)
rules.description: NSAIDs induce gastric mucosal ulceration while impairing platelet aggregation, multiplying severe GI hemorrhage risk.
rules.evidence: American College of Gastroenterology & ACC/AHA Antithrombotic Guidelines.
rules.recommendation: Avoid co-administration. Use paracetamol/acetaminophen for analgesia; prescribe PPI if co-prescription is unavoidable.

rules.title: Fatal Hypotension & Cardiovascular Collapse (PDE5-Inhibitor + Nitrate)
rules.description: Co-administration of PDE-5 inhibitors with organic nitrates produces synergistic cGMP accumulation, causing catastrophic systemic vasodilation, profound hypotension, myocardial infarction, and death.
rules.evidence: ACC/AHA Clinical Expert Consensus & FDA Black Box Contraindication.
rules.recommendation: ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED. Do not prescribe nitrates within 24 hours of sildenafil (48 hours for tadalafil).

rules.title: Lethal Bone Marrow Aplasia & Pancytopenia (Methotrexate + Trimethoprim/Cotrimoxazole)
rules.description: Both agents are dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors. Trimethoprim also reduces renal clearance of methotrexate, inducing life-threatening myelosuppression, pancytopenia, and toxic epidermal necrolysis.
rules.evidence: British National Formulary (BNF) & Rheumatology Clinical Safety Warnings.
rules.recommendation: CONTRAINDICATED. Discontinue trimethoprim/cotrimoxazole immediately. Select non-antifolate antibacterial (e.g. Nitrofurantoin/Cephalosporin).

rules.title: Life-Threatening Serotonin Syndrome (Serotonergic Agent + Linezolid)
rules.description: Linezolid is a reversible, non-selective MAO inhibitor. Co-administration with SSRIs, SNRIs, or Tramadol leads to toxic serotonin accumulation causing hyperthermia, rigidity, autonomic instability, and seizures.
rules.evidence: FDA Drug Safety Communication & Hunter Serotonin Toxicity Criteria.
rules.recommendation: Avoid combination. Withhold serotonergic medications or choose an alternative antibiotic (e.g. Vancomycin, Daptomycin).

rules.title: Severe Rhabdomyolysis & Myopathy (Statin + CYP3A4 Inhibitor)
rules.description: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (Clarithromycin, Itraconazole, Ketoconazole) markedly elevate plasma concentrations of CYP3A4-metabolized statins, provoking acute rhabdomyolysis and renal failure.
rules.evidence: FDA Statin Safety Advisory & AHA Cholesterol Management Guidelines.
rules.recommendation: Temporarily withhold statin therapy during course of macrolide/azole antifungal, or switch to Rosuvastatin/Pravastatin.

rules.title: Torsades de Pointes & Fatal Ventricular Arrhythmia (Additive QTc Prolongation)
rules.description: Concurrent administration of QT-prolonging antimicrobials (Azithromycin, Fluconazole) with antiemetics (Ondansetron, Domperidone) produces additive cardiac repolarization delay.
rules.evidence: CredibleMeds QTdrugs Registry & American Heart Association Scientific Statement.
rules.recommendation: Monitor baseline ECG / QTc interval. Substitute alternative antiemetic (e.g. Cyclizine) or antimicrobial if QTc > 480ms.

rules.title: Hyperkalemia Risk (ACE Inhibitor + Potassium-Sparing Diuretic)
rules.description: Additive inhibition of aldosterone leads to severe serum potassium elevation.
rules.recommendation: Monitor serum potassium and renal function within 1 week of co-prescription.

rules.title: Reduced Antibiotic Absorption (Fluoroquinolone + Cation Antacid)
rules.description: Chelation by multivalent cations reduces oral fluoroquinolone bioavailability by up to 90%.
rules.recommendation: Administer fluoroquinolone at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids.
